prompt: Our SRE team is preparing for a critical production deployment and needs a consolidated pre-deployment health snapshot of the current server. Please produce a single file called `health_report.json` that combines two things: (1) a complete system resource summary covering CPU, memory, and disk, and (2) a list of the top 5 most CPU-intensive processes currently running on the machine. The report must be machine-readable and structured so our automated deployment gate can parse and validate the values directly. Use the local system monitoring tooling already available in the workspace.
